{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any of these QA orders are in the 'new' + 'paid_search' group
qa_in_target_group = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"QA orders in 'new' + 'paid_search' group: {len(qa_in_target_group)}")

# Check if there are any refunded orders in the target group
refunded_in_target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f"Refunded orders in 'new' + 'paid_search' group: {len(refunded_in_target_group)}")

# Display the first few rows of the target group to verify
target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print("\nFirst few rows of target group:")
print(target_group.head())"}
